obernants.operator: U consists of pairs (A,B) of finite occurrence sequences. R(A,B) means B is the stable ascending permutation. U minus R includes changed length/multiplicity, descending adjacent keys, or reversal of equal-key identities. Under lawful comparison/clone these exhaust unsuccessful output candidates; bounded evidence is not general proof.
